theorems.statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), ∑ i, (a i - 1 / 2) ^ 2 < 1 / 16 → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∃ ψ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x, x ∉ La → ψ x ∈ ⋃ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ), latticeFace 1 F) ∧ (∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 4 → LipschitzOnWith (c / Real.toNNReal σ) ψ {x | σ ≤ infDist x La}
